title: Draft an invoice and order exception list
reason: A proposed mock compares fictional invoice text with operator-supplied order details and flags blank or visibly inconsistent fields for human review; it does not handle purchasing, calculate financial results or submit billing. Proposed narrow test: This overlaps the other invoice-review lead on invoice checking and has broader unrelated duties; no attached reference supports the remaining reporting or purchasing tasks. Five-criterion mean 4.8 is below the threshold of 6; no validated AI-service demand. It also overlaps the invoice-checking workflow in the selected invoice-review lead.
